title: Petal proposals v3
description: proposals/v3 (12 Nov; Elco, walk 3: 'there's no way for me to know what this proposal is about so maybe there's a link to wherever it was made maybe there is a summary') is proposals/v2 with each proposal's summary, its own text as its source says it, and a link to read it, saying what kind of link it is: where it was made (its own page: Snapshot's, DAOhaus's), or an address its text names (a Sputnik proposal has no page of its own, and the first address its text names is often its forum post, not where it was made). proposals/v2 (11 Nov; the L2 mapping wave and LOOK) is proposals/v1 with: an outcome 'closed' for a proposal whose voting closed and whose result its source doesn't state (Snapshot), never a guess; each proposal's recipient, where it pays or names one; its options' labels where a ballot chooses among them; and each ballot's choices and weights as said, with its for, against or abstain left null when that doesn't apply (weighted, quadratic, ranked choice). Weights are decimal text, since they can exceed exact JSON numbers. A DAO's proposals and how each account voted on each (board #93; Elco, 11 Nov: 'when a proposal is hovered little dots show up on the inside showing yes and no votes, absent votes show nothing'). One per map, named by the map's address, read from the DAO's own chain and read again to refresh. An account that didn't vote on a proposal isn't in its votes: absent, never a guess. Each vote keeps the DAO's own word for it.

about.description: the map, by its address (its card's id)

source.description: where they were read: the DAO's kind, its contract, the calls, and when

kind.description: the DAO's kind, in a word: sputnik, baal

ref.description: the calls or events they were read from

title.description: its title, from its own text: a Title line, or its first words

kind.description: what it does, in the DAO's own word (Transfer, ChangePolicy, …), or null

closes_at.description: when its voting closes: by the DAO's policy (Sputnik's proposal period from submission), or as the DAO set it (Baal's vote end); null when unknown

decided_at.description: when it was decided, where the DAO records it (Baal's processing); null where it doesn't (Sputnik)

as_said.description: the DAO's own word for its status

votes.description: each account that voted, once; an account that didn't is absent

vote.description: for, against or abstain; null when the ballot's choices don't fit those (weighted, quadratic, ranked choice): then choices says what it chose

as_said.description: the DAO's own word for the vote: Approve, Reject, Remove, true, false

at.description: when it was cast, where the DAO records it (Baal's event), or null (Sputnik)

choices.description: what the ballot chose, as said: each option (its label, or its number as the source gives it) and the weight given it, in decimal text, or null

power.description: the ballot's voting power as its source says it, in decimal text

recipient.description: who it pays or names: Sputnik's Transfer receiver_id, a payout's to; null when it names none or the reader can't tell

options.description: its options' labels, in order, where a ballot chooses among them (Snapshot); absent for yes or no

summary.description: the proposal's own text, whole, as its source says it (Sputnik's description without Astro's '$$$$' separator, a Baal proposal's details, Snapshot's body), or null when it has none

link.description: where to read it, and what kind of link that is, or null when there is none

kind.description: where it was made: the proposal's own page on its source; named in its text: an address the proposal's own text names, which may be a discussion, not where it was made
